reviews.classification: full actual JSON-map content review; overlapping static source depth and residual obligations preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all2581JSON lines through header, common dictionaries, all27routing blocks and every30MODULE/21NV-I/15DS/28R record. Every source path, why/remaining gap, status, prior obligation, deep-trace array and K/P/palette mapping was read. The [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/naev-family-view-receipt-b592.json) and [lossless view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/naev-family-lossless-view-b592.json) preserve exact reconstruction and unchanged source SHA85b5d6c371e9b09f4ddf50283ddb8d88b08fae2aae30ab90d21df1044e72a59f. Source pin f8982244800e86553217a2dba555a0f41c2b87ba remains this artifact's evidence identity, not present upstream head or current installed build.

F2:94records=30module+21semantic+15deep+28residual.25unread+10sampled-this-pass+18prior-partial+10extended-partial+15source-traced+13partial+3not-established=94. Module, semantic and deep rows overlap underlying source; counts cannot be added as independent mechanics. Sampled-this-pass means the historical source lane, not B592. Source-traced status retains every explicit remaining_gap and does not establish executed stock/charge/payment, UI, solver, migration or exact pending restoration. Prior U1–U7 obligations are refined by specific residual leaves, not silently closed by the15DSlabels.

F3: MODULE and NV-I family routing is deliberately broad and sometimes ill-fitting: dat/LICENSE sits under social/events, VN speech/menu under world/travel, port permission under authoring and log/HUD descriptions under body/combat. These bucket labels do not determine actual ownership of attribution, dialogue, access or public presentation. Their more precise DS/Rsource/consumer descriptions and existing owners govern selected uptake. Missing specialist rendering/audio or race/minigame owners are bounded lookup gaps, not absence of broad presentation/life owners or a mandate for new files. Palette paths are document-root names in this map, not automatically directory-relative Markdown links or verified runtime ports.

F4: DS01–DS05 preserve allocation/cargo/deployment versus ownership, pending capture versus paid recovery, impaired assets and repair eligibility, actual convoy survival/orders and constrained NPC equipment selection. Current remaining gaps explicitly exclude full capacity/admission/discard/death settlement, crash-atomic capture/payment, corrupt/missing quotes, exact reload equipment, all faction templates and solver/fallback behavior. A retained repair_cost with eligibility-marker removal is a source detail, not a reproduced double-charge bug. An equipment optimizer or escort interface is not full autonomous combat, personal relationship memory or a general hireling economy.

F5: DS06–DS10 preserve bioship skill/stage/respecialization versus reproduction/genome/lineage; physical mining outcome versus optional timing bonus and actual pickup; POI lead/scanner/reward identity versus generated-risk override; discovery records versus map flags; and knowledge-gated reference pipeline versus actual rendered usability. Replaced skill dependencies, zero-yield/pity, all reward modules/string puzzle, fresh-load trails and interruption remain open. One-time flavor flags in this source do not impose lifetime once-only useful events on OOPS. No birth/family support follows from a living-ship skill graph, nor actual difficulty from a generated risk label after override.

F6: DS11technology catalogue is local available supply, not automatic research or character competence. DS12sensing/scanning/stealth/target lock and later observer memory differ; actual knowledge cannot be inferred from detection alone. DS13effect lifetime/replacement/typed damage does not cover all heat/overflow/disable/stress/difficulty/injury. DS14special gate/wormhole contracts do not settle ordinary fuel admission, transport fleets, construction or interrupted passage. DS15market model and remembered samples do not prove every coefficient, reference cycle, purchase quantity curve, restock or stock conservation. Source-specific costs/restrictions remain local under AD38, with actual stronger means and independent owners allowed.

F7: All R01–R28 keep their why/source boundary: whole campaigns/relationships, all AI/faction/spawn/lanes/ordinary jumps/nebula/races/puzzles, claim/chapter anomaly, corrupt/missing-content restores/Flow/VN userdata, actual HUD/audio/input, canonical head, native YAIR uptake, full effects/plugin precedence/tutorial/transport/skill/reward/market/license and not-established achievements/genetics/households. A not-established row is not a whole-game absence proof. Common raw directory/class names and selected serialization cannot supply arbitrary VN cursor or crash-atomic recovery. Current PROJECT and AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 govern actual execution; no source body, extraction, live source fetch, game, model/worker, test/build/browser, private save, acquisition, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred. JSON bytes/schema and all useful original mappings/gaps remain unchanged.
reviews.evidence: Header/dictionaries/27routing blocks and all94records read in bounded lossless output; exact reconstruction and unchanged original SHA recorded in naev-family-view-receipt-b592.json.
reviews.reopen: Use precise selected DS/R consumer rather than broad inferred module family; source/runtime/persistence gaps remain explicit.

folds.body: The complete [Naev map B592 review](research/naev/pass-2026-10-14-systems/REPORT.md#content-reconciliation-b592-complete-map-and-residual-source-scope) preserves technology catalogue as local supply rather than research, knowledge or earned competence. Bioship progression/respecialization is not reproductive lineage; optimizer/convoy interfaces do not establish full agent economy or memory; sensor/scan/stealth and remembered observation differ. Mining method/timing bonus needs actual stock/pickup, and market samples/model are not full trading conservation or current prices. All94MODULE/NV-I/DS/Rrecords and27routing blocks were read with original JSON unchanged; source-traced status retains named native/save/caller/effect gaps. Broad family routing cannot replace actual source/command/observer/custody owners under AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52; no source/native/runtime was rerun.
